title: Security Indicator Classification
briefing: Classify each item as either a sign of compromise or a normal system behavior.
instructions: Drag each indicator into the correct category.

feedback.Unexpected outbound traffic: Correct. Unexpected outbound connections may indicate data exfiltration or command-and-control communication.
feedback.Repeated login failures: Correct. Multiple login failures may signal brute-force attempts or credential attacks.
feedback.Routine software update: Correct. Normal update processes are expected system activity.
feedback.Known system backup process: Correct. Scheduled backups are standard operational behavior.
